subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “A podcast did not replace study, but it gave history a heartbeat.”?
options: It became a reminder that an empty space can help people remember someone.
Problems are easier to fix when people look closely.
It also belonged to people not yet born.
Facts became easier to remember when they belonged to people.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「It became a reminder that an empty space can help people remember someone.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Problems are easier to fix when people look closely.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「It also belonged to people not yet born.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「A podcast did not replace study, but it gave history a heartbeat. Facts became easier to remember when they belonged to people.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「A podcast did not replace study, but it gave history a heartbeat. Facts became easier to remember when they belonged to people.」，答案為「Facts became easier to remember when they belonged to people.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Facts became easier to remember when they belonged to people.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
